overview: Astryx is an open-source design system from Meta with 150+ accessible React components, theming, dark mode, templates, and a CLI. It runs on React 19+ and StyleX but does not require a build plugin. Learners can study a large-scale component library built for both human developers and AI assistants.
how_to_start: Install React 19 or later as a peer dependency.
Run npm install @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex and npm install -D @astryxdesign/cli (or pnpm/yarn equivalents).
Optionally install the CLI globally with npm i -g @astryxdesign/cli for cross-project use.
Follow the quick-start guide in packages/core/README.md for CSS imports, theme provider setup, and framework-specific steps (Next.js, Tailwind, Vite, CDN).

read_these.why: Shows the minimal CSS imports and theme provider setup for any project.
Full component reference, theming guide, and API documentation.
Interactive component examples and playground for learning component props and variants.
Live editor to experiment with components without local setup.
Explains contribution workflow, coding standards, and how to propose changes.

first_contributions: Improve documentation examples in packages/core/README.md or package READMEs.
Add or update component stories in Storybook for better coverage.
Fix small TypeScript type issues or add missing JSDoc comments in component source.
Triage the single open good-first-issue labeled task when it appears.
watch_out: Project is in Beta — APIs may change before stable release.
Requires React 19+ which may not be the default in all starter templates.
StyleX is a peer dependency; learners unfamiliar with it face an extra learning curve.
Only one open good-first-issue at the moment, so first-timer opportunities are limited.
